lens: Shared three-area-light rig, orthographic lens at gameplay pitch (~43 deg), ortho scale 4.9 identical across all four directions

north.notes: Back side fully modeled: both rope bands arc over the load with knots/dangling ends on this face, braces and pegs read, sleeper feet ground the stack, no clipping. Staggered log ends are deliberate.

south.notes: Working face: two taut wraps, rail pegs, branch stub on the top log, sleepers visible beneath the bottom rail, foot stones seat every post. No floating members.

east.notes: End-on: endgrain cluster reads, short-log gap visible as authored, ropes hug the bundle with believable chord standoff only at curvature corners, stones and posts contact the ground.

west.notes: End-on: staggered caps at varied depths, bottom rope segment presses into the log undersides (no mid-air span), cross braces and rails join the posts cleanly.
